name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
description: A Michelin take on this easy weeknight meal.  Simple ingredients result in an elegant and silky creamy sauce with a subdued garlic taste.

steps.instruction: Peel the skin off the garlic and remove the germ from the middle of the clove.
Boil the garlic in water for 1 minute.  Strain and let rest for 1 minute.  Repeat 4 times
Cook the spaghetti to al dente, reserving some pasta water.
Combine the olive oil, garlic, and pasta water and blend until smooth
In a deep pan, add the sauce to the spaghetti and toss vigorously.  Add parsley and toss to mix
Twirl a serving of pasta into a bowl, top with sauce.
Finish with a sprinkle of cayenne pepper, if desired.

winePairings.name: 2019 Pierre-Yves Colin Meursault Les Charmes 1ER Cru
winePairings.notes: A complex Chardonnay with depth, elegance, and subtle mineral edge to complements the sauce

winePairings.name: 2022 Tenuta Sant'Antonio Scaligera Gargangea
winePairings.notes: A vibrant white with bright acidity and citrus notes to balance the dish
